# Eschaton CTF 2026 Quals - Writeups

My writeups for challenges from Eschaton CTF 2026 Qualifiers.

February 01, 2026 | 16 min read

## Overview

I played the Eschaton CTF 2026 Qualifiers with just one intention: to solve Android challenges from psychoSherlock and really had a great time solving those challenges. Here’s the writeup of all the Android challenges.

## Category: Android

1

### Hello World

Storage

#### Challenge Description
    
    `
    
    1
    

 | 
    
    Hello World
    

`

As the name suggests, this is a `Hello World` level challenge. You can download the handout from here: Official Link or here: Mirror Link.

So when we try to get what’s present in the `helloworld.dat`, we can see that it’s encrypted, so we can roughly guess it’s an Android Backup File. So we will be using `abe.jar` from Android Backup Extractor.
    
    `
    
    1
    2
    3
    

 | 
    
    sam-mg@MacBook-Air Eschaton CTF 2026 Quals % java -jar abe-540a57d.jar unpack Hello\ World/Assests/DATs/helloworld.dat Hello\ World/Assests/DATs/helloworld.tar
    This backup is encrypted, please provide the password
    Password: %  
    

`

So we can see that it’s password protected, so we have to brute-force the password. As guessed, GPT gave me a script to run with `rockyou.txt` wordlist to brute-force the password.
    
    `
    
    1
    2

 | 
    
    xargs -n 1 -P $(sysctl -n hw.ncpu) -I {} bash -c " \
      pw='{}'; \
      out='/tmp/helloworld_\$\$.tar'; \
      java -jar \"$ABE_JAR\" unpack \"$DAT\" \"\$out\" \"\$pw\" >/dev/null 2>&1; \
      if tar -tf \"\$out\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
          echo 'PASSWORD FOUND: '\$pw; \
          kill 0; \
      fi; \
      rm -f \"\$out\" \
    "

### Wintery News 2 (Miscellaneous 25)

問題はこうなっている。
    
    There's a collaborative security monitoring service that tracks global threats and publishes daily threat dashboards. Its name references meteorological phenomena. 
    What is the three-letter acronym for this center?

おそらくInternet Storm Center、ISCのことを言っている。
    
    atcctf_isc
    

### Did It Freeze the CLI? (Hacker Trivia 25)

問題はこうなっている。
    
    It's a cold December night, and you're troubleshooting network problems. 
    You want to list all the TCP sockets that are currently listening, along with the associated processes, but the previous command caused your terminal to freeze. 
    What modern two-letter command should you use to check your sockets and get home before the snowstorm arrives?

リッスンしているすべてのTCPソケットと関連プロセスを一覧表示する2文字のコマンドは以下の通り。
    
    ss
    
    atcctf_ss
